name: FTN ibis international capital and AI landscape
method: Public, source-backed landscape screening. Inclusion is not an endorsement, relationship, open-call guarantee or eligibility determination.

decisionLabels.PRIORITY: Directly relevant enough for a verified approach or active monitoring.
decisionLabels.PARTNER: Best pursued through a qualified institution, consortium or regional partner.
decisionLabels.EVALUATE: Useful technology or market signal; test before adoption.
decisionLabels.INDIRECT: Capital exists but is normally intermediated, institutional or too large for a direct early-stage application.
decisionLabels.NOT_CURRENT_FIT: Current rules or geography do not match FTN ibis.

records.name: UWI St. Augustine Artificial Intelligence Innovation Centre
records.fit: Trinidad-based regional AI research, governance, talent and institutional legitimacy.
records.nextMove: Propose a bounded provenance, Caribbean-data and opportunity-intelligence collaboration.

records.name: CTU Caribbean AI Task Force and Forum
records.fit: Regional AI governance, coordination and responsible adoption.
records.nextMove: Map ibis provenance and consent controls to the regional AI framework.

records.name: IDB Lab
records.kind: grants, equity, loans and ecosystem connections
records.fit: Development innovation, responsible AI, GovTech and inclusion in Latin America and the Caribbean.
records.nextMove: Track challenges and approach through a measurable public-interest pilot, not a generic chatbot pitch.

records.name: CDB and RevUP Caribbean
records.fit: Caribbean early-stage company scaling, mentorship, technology support and financing readiness.
records.nextMove: Confirm cohort access and prepare traction, governance and regional-impact evidence.

records.name: Morro Ventures
records.fit: Caribbean technology companies with post-revenue or scalable early-stage potential.
records.nextMove: Build a concise investor data room around recurring usage, defensible Caribbean data and regional expansion.

records.name: Innogen Delta I
records.fit: Early technology ventures and digital transformation; the fund states a portfolio diversity objective.
records.nextMove: Monitor investable-stage criteria and seek an introduction after proof of repeat usage and revenue.

records.name: Global Affairs Canada open international-assistance calls
records.fit: Potential inclusion, gender, governance and digital-development calls when exact applicant and geography rules match.
records.nextMove: Monitor the official open-calls page and qualify each call individually; do not assume CFLI or ODA eligibility for Trinidad and Tobago.

records.name: Canadian research partnerships with EDI requirements
records.fit: EDI is assessed in several Canadian research programs, but a qualified Canadian research lead is normally required.
records.nextMove: Pursue through a Canadian university partner with a substantive Caribbean research role and an evidence-based EDI plan.

records.name: Horizon Europe
records.fit: Trinidad and Tobago entities may participate in many calls but are not generally entitled to automatic EU funding.
records.nextMove: Join only calls that explicitly fund the country or secure consortium/self-funding support before committing proposal effort.

records.name: Women TechEU
records.fit: Relevant inclusion design, but current calls require an eligible women-led company in the EU or an associated country.
records.nextMove: Do not restructure ownership or add a nominal founder to chase the weighting. Reassess only if genuine leadership and establishment rules are met.

records.name: Japan-CARICOM Friendship and Cooperation Fund
records.fit: Active diplomatic cooperation pathway for CARICOM priorities; not presented as a direct startup grant portal.
records.nextMove: Develop a regional public-interest pilot suitable for CARICOM or a government/university sponsor.

records.name: Toyota Foundation 2026 International Grant Program
records.fit: The 2026 international program targets East, Southeast and South Asia and is closed.
records.nextMove: Monitor future research programs only where geography and project rules explicitly include Caribbean participation.

records.name: China-IDB co-financing mechanisms
records.fit: Capital supports sustainable growth, private investment, inequality reduction and some technology sectors through IDB structures.
records.nextMove: Treat as a future institutional-scale route through IDB/IDB Invest, not an early-stage open grant.

records.name: LatamGPT
records.kind: regional foundation model and data collaboration
records.fit: Regional data curation, sovereignty and culturally grounded model infrastructure.
records.nextMove: Explore Caribbean corpus contribution, evaluation and application-layer collaboration while preserving FTN data rights.

records.name: Qwen open-weight models
records.fit: Apache-2.0 open-weight families offer multilingual, speech and multimodal capabilities that may lower provider dependence.
records.nextMove: Benchmark a small self-hostable model on Caribbean language, provenance and tool-use tests before any production adoption.

records.name: DeepSeek
records.fit: Commercial use is permitted for some released models, subject to the exact model license and use restrictions.
records.nextMove: Use only in a provider-neutral evaluation lane after license, privacy, hosting and availability review.

records.name: GLM open models
records.fit: Open model releases advertise tool calling and commercial secondary development under their stated licenses.
records.nextMove: Benchmark the smallest viable model; avoid committing to hosted data transfer until privacy and jurisdiction review is complete.

records.name: Rwazi
records.fit: Useful benchmark for consented real-world signals and evidence-backed enterprise decisions.
records.nextMove: Differentiate ibis through Caribbean institutional context, public-source provenance, opportunity workflows and founder-controlled memory.
